parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

🌱
alternative[ɔ:ltə:rnətiv]n.
An alternative is something that you can choose instead of your first choice. (Từ thay thế, sự lựa chọn thay thế)
➜ Her first plan to make extra money seemed weak, so she chose an alternative.
🌱
avenue[ævənju:]n.
An avenue is a road, often a large one with buildings on each side. (Đại lộ, con đường lớn)
➜ Drive down this avenue and then turn left to go to the park.
🌱
belly[beli]n.
The belly is the stomach of a person or animal. (Bụng, dạ dày)
➜ His belly was full because he ate a lot of food.
🌱
bid[bid]n.
A bid to do something is an attempt to do it. (Sự nỗ lực, cố gắng)
➜ He made a bid to become the university's next president.
🌱
blow[blou]v.
To blow means to move air or move something through the air, as in the wind. (Thổi)
➜ The wind is blowing very hard today. We should stay inside.
🌱
conflict[kɑnflikt]n.
A conflict is a fight between different people or groups. (Sự xung đột, cuộc xung đột)
➜ The two nations had a conflict over which one could use the water in the river.
🌱
continent[kɑntənənt]n.
A continent is one of the seven large areas of land on the Earth. (Lục địa, châu lục)
➜ Asia is the largest continent.
🌱
current[kə:rənt]n.
A current is a steady and constant flow of air or water in a river or ocean. (Dòng chảy, dòng nước/khí)
➜ The ocean currents took the ship far off into the sea.
🌱
disrespect[disrispekt]n.
Disrespect is rudeness or a behavior that shows a lack of respect. (Sự thiếu tôn trọng, sự vô lễ)
➜ He showed disrespect by arguing with his boss during a meeting.
🌱
enthusiasm[inθu:ziæzəm]n.
Enthusiasm is a very strong good feeling about something. (Sự nhiệt tình, sự hăng hái)
➜ The crowd showed their enthusiasm for the soccer team by cheering loudly.
🌱
harsh[hɑ:rʃ]adj.
When something is harsh, it is very unpleasant. (Khắc nghiệt, thô ráp)
➜ The desert can be a very harsh environment.
🌱
lean[li:n]v.
To lean is to bend the body in a particular direction. (Tựa, dựa, nghiêng)
➜ The woman leaned against the counter because she was tired.
🌱
meantime[mi:ntaim]n.
The meantime is the time between two events. (Trong lúc đó, thời gian giữa hai sự việc)
➜ Ted began setting the table. In the meantime, I began preparing the food.
🌱
mischief[mistʃif]n.
Mischief is behavior that is meant to trick or cause trouble for people. (Trò nghịch ngợm, sự ranh mãnh)
➜ Ben was up to mischief when he persuaded Ken to paint his face.
🌱
muscle[mʌsl]n.
Muscle is a mass of tissue attached to bone that helps you move. (Cơ bắp)
➜ She went to the gym in order to make her muscles stronger.
🌱
rescue[reskju:]v.
To rescue someone means to remove them from danger. (Cứu nguy, giải cứu)
➜ The firefighter rescued the man from the burning building.
🌱
succession[səkseʃən]n.
A succession is a number of things that follow one after the other. (Sự liên tiếp, chuỗi liên tục)
➜ The student said the letters of the alphabet in succession.
🌱
terrain[tərein]n.
The terrain is the land and all of its physical features or parts. (Địa hình)
➜ The terrain below was rocky and full of hills.
🌱
timid[timid]adj.
If someone is timid, they are afraid, shy, or nervous. (Rụt rè, bẽn lẽn)
➜ The timid child hides behind her mother whenever she sees a stranger.
🌱
violence[vaiələns]n.
Violence is forceful action that is meant to injure or kill people. (Bạo lực)
➜ The boy hit his brother in an act of violence.

sections.title: Exercise 2
sections.content: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the bracketed part.

questions.content: Australia is an island that is also the smallest [large area of land] on the planet.
questions.explanation: "large area of land" (khu vực đất rộng lớn) có nghĩa tương đương với "continent" (lục địa).

questions.content: The land's [feature] was quite hilly.
questions.explanation: "feature" (đặc điểm địa hình) trong ngữ cảnh này tương đương với "terrain" (địa hình).

questions.content: The pitcher threw the balls to home plate in a [series, one after another].
questions.explanation: "series, one after another" (chuỗi liên tiếp) tương đương với "succession" (sự liên tiếp).

questions.content: The student left for school early. She had to walk down an [extended road] to get there.
questions.explanation: "extended road" (con đường kéo dài) tương đương với "avenue" (đại lộ).

questions.content: Brian was tired. He needed to [bend over and rest] on the side of his car.
questions.explanation: "bend over and rest" (cúi người và nghỉ ngơi) tương đương với "lean" (tựa, dựa).

questions.content: The student decided that the answer was A and not the [other choice], B.
questions.explanation: "other choice" (sự lựa chọn khác) tương đương với "alternative" (sự lựa chọn thay thế).

questions.content: The river's [fast steady movement of water] made it difficult to swim to the other side.
questions.explanation: "fast steady movement of water" (sự di chuyển nhanh và ổn định của nước) tương đương với "current" (dòng chảy).

questions.content: He talked about US history, and the pupils wrote notes in the [time during the event].
questions.explanation: "time during the event" (thời gian diễn ra sự kiện) tương đương với "meantime" (trong lúc đó).

questions.content: The dog continued barking. The loud noise was painful and [rough] to her ears.
questions.explanation: "rough" (thô ráp, chói tai) tương đương với "harsh" (khắc nghiệt, chói tai).

questions.content: The boys used [forceful action] to get what they wanted.
questions.explanation: "forceful action" (hành động dùng sức mạnh) tương đương với "violence" (bạo lực).

sections.title: Exercise 3
sections.content: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: Which word best describes a student who is very happy and excited?
questions.explanation: Sự nhiệt tình, hào hứng (Enthusiasm) mô tả một học sinh rất vui vẻ và phấn khích.

questions.content: Which of the following describes a scared person best?
questions.explanation: Rụt rè, sợ hãi (Timid) mô tả tốt nhất một người đang sợ hãi.

questions.content: What is something that can be soft and round?
questions.explanation: Bụng của một người (belly) có thể mềm và tròn.

questions.content: Which word best describes behavior meant to trick or cause trouble?
questions.explanation: Trò nghịch ngợm (Mischief) là hành vi nhằm trêu chọc hoặc gây rắc rối.

questions.content: Which of the following best describes the action of the wind?
questions.explanation: Gió thổi (blows).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Sun and the North Wind

The Sun and the North Wind were talking to each other in the sky. The North Wind was saying that he was better than everyone else. The Sun listened as the North Wind talked with enthusiasm about how powerful he was and how he could push something from one continent to another with one breath. He said, “I am the strongest thing in the sky.”

“Really?” asked the Sun. “How do you know that you are more powerful than the stars, or the rain, or even me?”

The North Wind laughed with disrespect. He yelled, “You? That’s a joke!”

This hurt the Sun. He was usually timid and did not want to cause conflict. Today he decided that he should teach the North Wind a lesson.

In the meantime, a man began walking along the avenue down on Earth. When the Sun looked down on the terrain below, he saw the man. He pointed down to the Earth and said, “Do you see that man walking below? I bet I can get his jacket off of him. Can you?”

“Of course!” the North Wind replied as he took a deep breath and filled his lungs with air. He used all of his muscles in his face and belly to blow winds at his target in succession.

The harsh air currents made the man cold. The man pulled his jacket more tightly around him. It did not come off. The Sun decided to rescue the man from the mischief of the North Wind. He said, “May I try?” Then he sent down sunlight that made the man warm. The man leaned against a tree. He took off his jacket and enjoyed the nice weather.

“You are very powerful,” the Sun said to the North Wind, “but you use violence in your bid to appear strong. You should think of an alternative. The strongest people don’t use force to get what they want.”

questions.content: The North Wind thought that he was stronger than everyone else.
questions.explanation: Gió Bắc cho rằng mình mạnh hơn tất cả mọi người.

questions.content: The North Wind blew the jacket off of the man.
questions.explanation: Gió Bắc không thể thổi bay chiếc áo khoác của người đàn ông.

questions.content: The North Wind treated the Sun with disrespect.
questions.explanation: Gió Bắc đối xử với Mặt trời bằng sự thiếu tôn trọng.

questions.content: The Sun was the target for the North Wind.
questions.explanation: Mục tiêu của Gió Bắc là người đàn ông trên đường, không phải Mặt trời.

questions.content: The Sun was timid and did not teach the North Wind a lesson.
questions.explanation: Mặt trời tuy thường rụt rè nhưng đã quyết định dạy cho Gió Bắc một bài học.

questions.content: The North Wind used violence in his bid to be powerful.
questions.explanation: Gió Bắc đã sử dụng bạo lực trong nỗ lực tỏ ra mạnh mẽ.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension - Part B
sections.content: Answer the questions.

questions.content: Why was the North Wind so full of enthusiasm?
options: He was going on a date.
questions.explanation: Gió Bắc tràn đầy sự nhiệt tình vì anh ta cho rằng mình có sức mạnh vô song.

questions.content: Why did the North Wind fill his lungs with air?
options: To find an alternative to violence
To blow air at his target
questions.explanation: Gió Bắc hít đầy không khí vào phổi để thổi vào mục tiêu của mình.

questions.content: How was the North Wind causing mischief?
options: By blowing harsh wind at the man
questions.explanation: Gió Bắc gây ra trò nghịch ngợm bằng cách thổi luồng gió khắc nghiệt vào người đàn ông.

questions.content: What happened in the meantime while the Sun and the North Wind were talking?
options: The man felt the cold air currents.
The man took off his jacket.
The man began walking along the avenue.
questions.explanation: Trong lúc đó (meantime), một người đàn ông bắt đầu đi dọc theo đại lộ.
